news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.33 (vs ₹4.26 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.33 (up from ₹4.26 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹11.9b (up 18% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹663.2m (up 1.7% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.6% (down from 6.5% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 17% growth forecast for the Life Sciences industry in India.

news.title: AKUMS: Zambia Manufacturing Buildout Will Support Future Earnings Expansion
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals unchanged at ₹646.67, citing only modest tweaks to inputs such as a slightly lower discount rate and a marginally softer future P/E assumption, rather than any shift in the underlying company outlook. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for February 13, 2026, to consider and approve the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and nine months ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Feb 13, 2026
news.body: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results on Feb 13, 2026

news.title: AKUMS: Zambia Expansion And Senior Leadership Moves Will Support Earnings
news.body: Analysts have kept their fair value estimate for Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals steady at ₹646.67, with only marginal adjustments to the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions. This reflects fine tuning of their models rather than a change in overall view.

news.title: AKUMS: Zambia Manufacturing Buildout Will Support Future Margins And Earnings
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals to ₹646.67 from ₹638.33, citing updated assumptions around revenue growth, profit margins, and a slightly different forward P/E framework. What's in the News The Board approved an investment of US$24 million (about ₹2,000 million) in Akums Healthcare (Zambia) Private Limited, a recently incorporated subsidiary in Zambia, to be infused through equity and or debt secured by MIGA insurance (Board meeting filing).

news.title: AKUMS: Zambian Manufacturing Expansion Will Support Future Earnings And Margin Strength
news.body: Analysts have modestly revised their price target for Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals to ₹638.33 per share, reflecting slightly lower discount rate and future P/E assumptions while maintaining their outlook on revenue growth and profit margins. What's in the News The board has approved a USD 24 million (about INR 2,000 million) investment in subsidiary Akums Healthcare Zambia to establish a manufacturing facility and expand its presence in Zambia and neighboring African markets, with funding via equity and/or debt secured by MIGA insurance (Key Developments).

news.title: AKUMS: Zambian Expansion Will Drive Earnings Momentum And Future Market Reach
news.body: Analysts have maintained their price target for Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals at ₹638.33, noting only minimal adjustments to underlying assumptions such as the discount rate and future earnings expectations. What's in the News The board of Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals approved an investment of USD 24 million (INR 2000 million approx.) in its Zambian subsidiary to establish a manufacturing facility and expand business in African markets (Board Meeting, Nov 13, 2025).

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 14%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2026 has deteriorated. 2026 revenue forecast decreased from ₹44.0b to ₹42.3b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹18.75 per share to ₹16.20 per share. Net income forecast to shrink 3.5% next year vs 16% growth forecast for Life Sciences industry in India . Consensus price target down from ₹692 to ₹638. Share price fell 3.6% to ₹422 over the past week.

news.title: Price target decreased by 7.7% to ₹638
news.body: Down from ₹692, the current price target is an average from 3 analysts. New target price is 50% above last closing price of ₹425. Stock is down 27% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹16.20 for next year compared to ₹22.60 last year.

news.title: AKUMS: Investment in Zambia Subsidiary Will Drive Stronger Earnings Momentum
news.body: Analysts have revised their price target for Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals downward from ₹691.67 to ₹638.33, citing updated assessments of growth prospects and market conditions. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for November 13, 2025, at 14:30 IST to review and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Price target decreased by 11% to ₹668
news.body: Down from ₹750, the current price target is an average from 3 analysts. New target price is 52% above last closing price of ₹441. Stock is down 20% over the past year. The company is forecast to post earnings per share of ₹17.00 for next year compared to ₹22.60 last year.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.66 (vs ₹4.37 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.66 (down from ₹4.37 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹10.5b (up 1.6% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹407.8m (down 38% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.9% (down from 6.3% in 2Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 17% growth forecast for the Life Sciences industry in India.
